parameters.query:
-- Summarised articles whose picture nobody has looked for yet, newest
-- first: from the sources whose pages we read, and only while their
-- text is kept. Ten a run, so a slow site cannot hold the run up past
-- n8n's time limit. See db/init/28-article-pictures.sql.
SELECT i.id, coalesce(i.canonical_url, i.source_url) AS url
  FROM items i
  JOIN sources s ON s.id = i.source_id
 WHERE i.status = 'summarised'
   AND i.picture_status IS NULL
   AND i.text_removed_at IS NULL
   AND s.picture_rights <> 'none'
   AND coalesce(i.canonical_url, i.source_url) ~* '^https?://'
 ORDER BY i.id DESC
 LIMIT 10;

-- No picture on the page (none), or the page or the picture could not
-- be read (failed): not looked for again.
UPDATE items SET picture_status = $1, picture_url = nullif($2, '')
 WHERE id = $3::bigint AND picture_status IS NULL;
